prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write strict TypeScript module solution.ts and export the named function.
Required API: export function ringBufferTrace(capacity: number, values: readonly number[]): number[] | null
Behavior: Simulate a fixed-capacity FIFO ring. Each value is pushed; emit the evicted oldest value, or -1 when no eviction occurs. Reject non-positive capacity and input value -1, which is reserved as the sentinel. Do not mutate input; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: capacity 2 with values [4,7,9,1] returns [-1,-1,4,7].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: export function ringBufferTrace(capacity:number,values:readonly number[]):number[]|null{if(!Number.isInteger(capacity)||capacity<=0)return null;const q:number[]=[],out:number[]=[];for(const v of values){if(!Number.isSafeInteger(v)||v===-1)return null;out.push(q.length===capacity?q.shift()!:-1);q.push(v)}return out}
